clearance.reason: carries about 1.6 kg plus the torque of expression-pedal travel
clearance.base_pan: flat stamped steel, exposed once the stock rubber feet are removed

open_questions: MANUAL_TODOS item 1: the stock feet must stay in place, so the plate needs edge-finger mounts that clear them.
No QuickMount type covers a Whammy; type H is DigiTech compact only.
notes: Do not mix this footprint with the Whammy IV (200.0 x 203.2 mm). They are different pedals with the same screw thread.
Power is 9V DC centre-negative on the V, 9V AC on the IV; that difference is a reliable way to tell them apart in the field.
Non-countersunk heads: the plate takes plain clearance holes, no 90 degree profile.
